subject_name: Souls of those who have died

phase_prompt.label: Default
phase_prompt.summary: The souls appear as a collective cluster of refractive errors and heat distortion, lingering in the dark buffer zone of the simulation, surrounded by the debris of their termination metadata.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Wide cinematic shot of a cluster of transparent, refractive human silhouettes floating in a dark, structured data void. The figures look like living heat distortion or warped glass. They are surrounded by a cloud of flickering golden Geez glyphs. The background is a rigid grid of obsidian and black metal, contrasting with the organic, chaotic glitching of the souls. The lighting is dim, moody, and dramatic, highlighting the edges of the refractive forms. Photorealistic, 8k, volumetric fog.
